camel_example: aliyun sas UpdateOssScanConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AutoAdd 1 --KeySuffixList.1 '.asp' --BucketNameList.1 'hz-new020000' --ScanDayList.1 1 --EndTime '00:00:01' --StartTime '00:00:00' --DecompressMaxFileCount 100 --RealTimeIncr true --DecompressMaxLayer 1 --Source OSS --Name testStrategy --AllKeyPrefix true --DecryptionList.1 KMS --KeyPrefixList.1 '/root' --LastModifiedStartTime 1724301769834 --Enable 0 --Id 11410000
description_en: Updates the OSS file scan policy configuration for the malicious file detection feature
description_zh: 恶意文件检测功能下，更新OSS文件检测策略配置
kebab_example: aliyun sas update-oss-scan-config --enable 0 --scan-day-list 1 --bucket-name-list hz-new020000 --key-suffix-list .asp --start-time 00:00:00 --end-time 00:00:01 --id 11410000 --key-prefix-list /root --name testStrategy --all-key-prefix true --decompress-max-layer 1 --decompress-max-file-count 100 --decryption-list KMS --last-modified-start-time 1724301769834 --real-time-incr true --auto-add 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateOssScanConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the policy. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The scan days. The number indicates the day of the week
parameters.help_zh: 扫描时间，数字表示一周中的第几天
parameters.name: scan_day_list

parameters.help_en: The scan start time in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The scan stop time in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to match all file prefixes
parameters.help_zh: 是否匹配所有文件前缀
parameters.name: all_key_prefix

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of decompression layers when multiple levels of nested compressed files exist. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 5. When the maximum number of decompression layers is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 存在多个层级的压缩包嵌套时的最大解压层数，最小取值为1，最大取值为5。超过最大解压层数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_layer

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of files to decompress. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000. When the maximum number of decompressed files is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected
parameters.help_zh: 最大解压文件数。最小取值为1，最大取值为1000。超过最大解压文件数时，解压操作将直接结束，已解压出文件的检测不受影响
parameters.name: decompress_max_file_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies that only files whose last modification time is after the specified timestamp are scanned. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检测最后一次修改时间在指定时间戳之后的文件，单位毫秒
parameters.name: last_modified_start_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable real-time incremental detection. When this parameter is set to true, the ScanDayList, StartTime, and EndTime parameters do not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启实时增量检测。此参数设置为true时，参数ScanDayList、StartTime、EndTime不生效
parameters.name: real_time_incr

parameters.help_en:
The business source. Valid values:
OSS: OSS
NAS: NAS
parameters.help_zh:
业务来源。取值：
OSS：OSS
NAS：NAS
parameters.name: source

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
